name: Connect in order
description: Connect the circles in order: numbers first (1-2-3…), then alternating numbers and letters (1-A-2-B…). Trains speed, flexibility and alternating attention.
instructions:
Tap the circles in order, as fast as you can without mistakes.
Start from the green circle "1": tap 2, then 3, then 4…
If you tap the wrong circle it turns red: find the right one and carry on.
instructionsKids: Join the dots in order: 1, 2, 3… like in a puzzle book! ✏️
hintB: Alternate numbers and letters: 1 → A → 2 → B → 3 → C …
partB:
Great! Now the second part: alternate a number and a letter, in order.
1 → A → 2 → B → 3 → C …
printA: Join the circles with a line in numerical order (1-2-3…), without lifting the pen.
printB: Join the circles alternating numbers and letters in order (1-A-2-B-3-C…), without lifting the pen.
